symbols.name: NguFieldHarness
symbols.summary: Harness for one `<ngu-field>`: read its label, state and messages, and enter values.

members.name: hostSelector
members.description: Selector of the harness's host element: `ngu-field`.

members.name: with
members.description: Matches fields by label, model path or type.

members.name: getLabel
members.description: The label, without the asterisk of required fields.

members.name: getPath
members.description: The model path, such as `account.email` or `items.0.sku`.

members.name: getType
members.description: The `type` from the spec.

members.name: getError
members.description: The error message on screen, or `null`. Errors appear per `errorsOn`.

members.name: getHint
members.description: The hint on screen, or `null`. An error, warning or pending text shows in its place.

members.name: getWarning
members.description: The warning on screen, without its "Warning:" prefix for screen readers.

members.name: isInvalid
members.description: True while an error shows.

members.name: isDisabled
members.description: True while the field is disabled.

members.name: isRequired
members.description: True when the label shows the required asterisk (`.ngu-required`); a single checkbox has none.

members.name: isPending
members.description: True while an async check runs.

members.name: getValue
members.description: The value as shown; see `NguFieldValue`.

members.name: setValue
members.description:
Enters a value the way a user would, then leaves the field. Text is typed key by key, so
masks, transforms and `onChange` run; choices are picked by their label.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focuses the field's control.

members.name: blur
members.description: Leaves the field, as a user tabbing away: it becomes touched and may show its error.

symbols.name: NguFieldHarnessFilters
symbols.summary: Filters for `NguFieldHarness.with`, on top of the CDK base filters (`selector`, `ancestor`).

members.name: label
members.description: The label text, without the required asterisk.

members.name: path
members.description: The model path, with numbers for list rows: `items.0.sku`.

members.name: type
members.description: The field's `type`.

symbols.name: NguFieldValue
symbols.summary:
A value as the user sees and enters it: text for inputs, `true`/`false` for checkboxes and
switches, option labels for selects, radios and segments, a list of labels for checkbox
groups and multiple selects, a list of tags, and `{ from, to }` for date ranges.

symbols.name: NguFormHarness

members.name: hostSelector
members.description: Selector of the harness's host element: `ngu-form`.

members.name: with
members.description: Matches forms by the CDK base filters, `selector` and `ancestor`.

members.name: field
members.description: The field at a model path (`items.0.sku`), or with this label. Throws when there is none.

members.name: fields
members.description: Every field on screen; hidden fields, closed steps and collapsed rows are not rendered.

members.name: list
members.description: The list at a model path, such as `items`.

members.name: fill
members.description: Enters each value into the field at its model path (or label), in order.

members.name: submit
members.description: Presses the submit button, or submits the form when it has none.

members.name: next
members.description: Presses Next in a wizard.

members.name: back
members.description: Presses Back in a wizard.

members.name: getStep
members.description: The heading of the wizard step on screen, such as "Step 2 of 4: Address".

members.name: getErrors
members.description: Errors on screen by model path; a form-level error is under `$form`.

members.name: getFormError
members.description: The form-level error: from `$form`, a string returned by the action, or a failed load.

members.name: isBusy
members.description: True while the form submits or loads (`aria-busy`).

symbols.name: NguFormHarnessFilters
symbols.summary: Filters for `NguFormHarness.with`: the CDK base filters (`selector`, `ancestor`).

symbols.name: NguListHarness
symbols.summary: Harness for a list (`<ngu-array>`): count, add and remove rows.

members.name: hostSelector
members.description: Selector of the harness's host element: `ngu-array`.

members.name: with
members.description: Matches lists by model path or title.

members.name: getPath
members.description: The model path, such as `items`, or `null`.

members.name: getTitle
members.description: The list's title, or `''` when it has none.

members.name: getRowCount
members.description: Rows on screen (long lists render only the rows in view).

members.name: addRow
members.description: Presses the add button.

members.name: removeRow
members.description: Presses the remove button of the row at `index`.

members.name: getRowFields
members.description: The fields of the row at `index`.

symbols.name: NguListHarnessFilters
symbols.summary: Filters for `NguListHarness.with`, on top of the CDK base filters (`selector`, `ancestor`).

members.name: path
members.description: The model path of the list, such as `items`.

members.name: title
members.description: The list title.
